centre.address: 651 Victoria St, Kamloops, BC V2C 2B3, Canada

about_blocks.text: Trudy is a Registered Professional Counsellor and a Master Practitioner in Counselling Psychology who offers individual and group counselling for addictions and is a board certified Interventionist. Trudy has participated in numerous interventions with families and is able to travel to provide her intervention service. Trudy is also a Certified Interventionist and a member of the Association of Intervention Specialists. Trudy has planned and participated in numerous interventions with alcoholics and drug addicts. Trudy has personally experienced alcoholism and understands first-hand the effects of addiction and how difficult it is to change your life to bring an end to substance abuse.

sponsor.text: Are you or a loved one struggling with alcohol or drug addiction? Finding the right addiction treatment centre can make all the difference in achieving long-term recovery. That's why we've done the research for you and compiled a list of the best alcohol and drug addiction centres in Canada. Our list includes top-rated addiction treatment centres that provide evidence-based therapies, personalized treatment plans, and aftercare support services to help clients overcome addiction and maintain a healthy, fulfilling life in recovery. Whether you're looking for residential or outpatient treatment, we've got you covered. For immediate treatment help call: 1-855-885-4747
